segments.text: You're at a party. Which one's worse? Wine or diet coke? Let's take a look. Caramel color, aspartame, phosphoric acid, potassium benzoate, natural flavors, citric acid, and caffeine. Sucralose and aspartame may disrupt your microbiome. Diet Coke may also increase the risk of type 2 diabetes, heart disease, and stroke. Wine, on the other hand, has a halo effect for high culture. Wine has between 12 and 14% alcohol. It is a class one carcinogen.
One drink a day can increase the risk for several cancers. If I'm at a party and the choice is diet coke or alcohol, I'm going to choose dehydration.
